title: Learning Teacher Output Preferences from Final Responses for Reasoning Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.30338v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many large language models (LLMs) use chain-of-thought (CoT) to solve complex problems, but hide their CoT traces to prevent reasoning capabilities from being distilled. While recent studies have shown that hidden CoTs can be reconstructed, existing methods typically require training a separate attacker for each target LLM. This paper studies model-agnostic CoT reconstruction, aiming to reconstruct hidden CoT traces from arbitrary target LLMs using only input prompts and visible final responses. We propose Final-Output Preference Learning (FOPL), which trains a single reconstruction model that generalizes to unseen LLMs without target-specific adaptation. To achieve this, the reconstruction model must learn which reasoning patterns match a given final response without knowing the target LLM's identity. translated_title: 从最终响应中学习教师输出偏好以实现推理蒸馏
translated_abstract: 许多大型语言模型（LLM）使用思维链（CoT）来解决复杂问题，但会隐藏其CoT轨迹，以防止推理能力被蒸馏。尽管近期研究表明隐藏的CoT可以被重构，但现有方法通常需要为每个目标LLM单独训练一个攻击模型。本文研究模型无关的CoT重构，旨在仅利用输入提示和可见的最终响应，从任意目标LLM中重构隐藏的CoT轨迹。我们提出了最终输出偏好学习方法（FOPL），训练单一的重构模型，使其能够泛化到未见过的LLM，而无需针对特定目标进行适配。为实现这一目标，重构模型必须在不知道目标LLM身份的情况下，学习哪些推理模式与给定的最终响应相匹配。我们通过偏好优化来解决这一问题，训练重构模型在给定最终响应时偏好原生CoT而非合成的替代方案。
tldr: 该论文提出最终输出偏好学习方法（FOPL），通过偏好优化训练单一模型，仅凭输入提示和最终响应即可从任意未知的LLM中重构其隐藏的思维链，实现模型无关的推理蒸馏。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Final-Output Preference Learning (FOPL), which trains a single model via preference optimization to reconstruct hidden chain-of-thought traces from any LLM using only input prompts and final responses, enabling model-agnostic reasoning distillation.
